headline: From a name in the search box to useful Danish phrases
overview: Mira uses the world explorer to find Copenhagen, changes the geographic view, then follows the place's own language path into public phrases she can actually use.
payoff: She leaves the explorer with a visible set of essential Danish phrases tied to the city she chose.

scenes.title: Mira opens the world with only a city name
scenes.narrative: She is on her phone and has one question—what thread should she follow into Copenhagen? The explorer offers search, layers, a world view, and a place index without asking her to sign in first.
frameCaptions: Mira opens the world with only a city name

scenes.title: The world narrows to one plausible result
scenes.narrative: The index collapses to **Copenhagen · City · Europe**. Mira gets a specific destination without wrestling with region filters or guessing a category.
frameCaptions: The world narrows to one plausible result

scenes.title: Copenhagen becomes a place, not a pin
scenes.narrative: The selected-place view gives Mira a concise orientation and three routes forward: language, people, or the full destination guide. The explorer has converted a search result into a decision.
frameCaptions: Copenhagen becomes a place, not a pin

scenes.title: She changes perspective without losing the place
scenes.narrative: The projection switches while Copenhagen stays selected. Mira can orient geographically without starting the search again or losing the paths she just found.
frameCaptions: She changes perspective without losing the place

scenes.title: The city opens into words she can use
scenes.narrative: The next page is not a generic language upsell. It is Copenhagen's public guide to essential Danish phrases, organised around daily life, work, culture, and emergencies.
frameCaptions: The city opens into words she can use
scenes.action: Opened "Learn a little of the language".

scenes.title: She reaches the practical first phrases
scenes.narrative: Mira finishes with the daily-life section visible on her phone. The journey has moved from curiosity to a concrete first preparation step without requiring an account.
frameCaptions: She reaches the practical first phrases
scenes.action: Scrolled to the Daily life phrase group.
